objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-screen-capture-in-temp-folder
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of screen capture files by the Braodo stealer malware. This stealer is known to capture screenshots of the victim's desktop as part of its data theft activities. The detection focuses on identifying unusual screen capture activity, especially when images are saved in directories often used by malware, such as temporary or hidden folders.
